title: Offline submission outbox is missing even though local IndexedDB draft persistence now exists

original_titles.title: Offline outbox with in-order idempotent replay missing (WS-08a S1)
Offline persistence stack (IndexedDB bhctf-v1, outbox, local drafts) entirely missing
No IndexedDB draft buffer or unsent queue; the four-state UI contract is unmet
No IndexedDB draft buffer or offline submission queue
Offline resilience and sync-state UX requirements not implemented
DraftSync partial: 3s interval only, no merge prompt on 409, no pagehide/sendBeacon flush, no local persistence (C-55)
Workspace core UX gaps: no Monaco, no multi-tab, no command palette, no offline outbox
No IndexedDB draft queue, offline resubmission, or React error boundaries
Draft sync: 3s fixed interval, no pagehide/sendBeacon flush, conflict auto-discards local edits, no status chips
No connection indicator in the workspace header (5 states)
Idempotency key discarded on failed attempt, breaking the stability guarantee

problem: LevelWorkspace now saves drafts to IndexedDB and synchronizes a versioned server draft, but there is no durable IndexedDB outbox for submit operations. The idempotency key is held in a component ref, so it survives in-page retry but not reload/tab crash. OfflineBanner exists but is not connected as a full queued-submit state machine.
impact: A network loss after the server accepted a submission but before the client receives the receipt can leave the participant uncertain. If the page reloads, the same idempotency key may be lost and the user may create a new request.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Extend IndexedDB with an outbox store keyed by stable mutation id and scoped to user/event/route. Persist exact payload hash, idempotency key, queued_at, attempt count and last error.
Persist the submission record before the network request. On response 202, atomically mark it acknowledged and store the receipt; on timeout/network error keep it queued with the same key.
Flush queued mutations in order when online and on application resume, with exponential backoff and a bounded concurrency policy. Never generate a new key for an ambiguous existing mutation.
Show durable UI states: saved locally, syncing, submitted/receipt confirmed, conflict, failed-needs-action. Show an exact pending count and provide a safe retry path.
Add browser tests for lost response after server commit, reload before receipt, offline queue order, repeated flush and per-user logout cleanup.

acceptance_criteria: An accepted submission survives tab reload/network loss without duplicate creation.
The same Idempotency-Key is reused until a definitive server response.
The participant sees an accurate queued/pending count and receipt after reconnection.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: The old claim that no IndexedDB/local draft persistence exists is fixed. The remaining defect is specifically durable offline mutation queue and cross-reload idempotency.
